messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: INC-202603 - rollout-latency-burst (service: inference-hosted). Trigger: canary p95 latency > 5s on /v1/generate. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-202603
marie: acked the page — I'm oncall. seeing p95 spikes in the canary region (us-west-2).
joel: digging in logs now. 503 spike + increased tail latency. kvcache miss rate jumped 4x on canary nodes.
katie: any confirmed customer impact? cc: @support-team
marie: short answer: yes, a subset of customers hitting the canary saw elevated errors and latency. SLOs burning at ~02:15.
joel: checked recent rollout: llm-embed-v2 deployed at 02:11 -> canary 10%. suspected quant kernel path enabled for this variant.
darren: seeing OOM kills in the quant executor on qnode-7. tail of pod logs: ```OOMKilled: process=quant_runner vmsize=32GB```
katie: we need mitigation plan: (A) divert canary traffic, (B) scale down canary pool, (C) rollback if symptoms persist. Who can run the traffic patch?
darren: taking traffic diversion now. patching traffic-split to 0% for canary.
darren: PATCH /api/traffic -> {"service":"inference-hosted","splits":{"canary":0,"stable":100}} :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Auto-suppression: further canary alerts will be suppressed for 10m while mitigation proceeds.
joel: confirming qnode kernel OOM at 02:17, correlates with increased kvcache misses. full snippet: ```2026-03-15T02:17:12Z ERROR quant_runner OOMKilled```
marie: rollback policy: if error rate or p95 not back within 10m after traffic diversion, we will rollback the canary. Joel, are you ready to roll back?
joel: rolling rollback now: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/llm-embed-v2 --to-revision=4```
joel: rollout-until-ready... pods replacing. healthchecks passing on new replicas.
joel: rollback complete, canary artifact reverted. p95 returned to baseline (~200ms) and 503s dropped to normal. :thumbsup:
katie: preparing customer communication. draft: "We're reverting a canary release that caused elevated latency for a subset of customers. No data loss, service restored. We'll follow up with a postmortem." Posting to status page and CS.
darren: handing over monitoring to night oncall: @alex you're up — watching for any regressions and will keep PD ticket updated.
alex: ack — monitoring p95 and error rate, checks every 15m, will escalate if anything reappears.
marie: follow-ups: collect core dumps from qnode-7, run model memory profiling, disable quant path in canary config until we have a safe rollout test. I'll open INC-202603 follow-up ticket for postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident INC-202603 marked RESOLVED by marie. Duration: 00:23:44. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-202603/resolved
